headline: Mistakes to Avoid When Replacing Your Windows
articleBody: Getting new windows is a big deal for your home's comfort and value, so let's make sure you don't stumble! A common misstep is picking the cheapest option without considering energy efficiency. Those ultra-low-cost windows often lack features like Low-E glass or Argon gas, which are crucial for keeping your energy bills down in the long run. Another big one is trying to DIY it or hiring an unlicensed contractor. Window installation is precise work, and if it's not done right, you'll end up with leaks, drafts, and headaches. Don't forget to factor in your home's architectural style when choosing new windows; you want them to enhance, not detract from, your curb appeal. Finally, skipping the consultation phase can lead to regretting your choices.
